implementation.authority: SupplyNativeProof reads public Core army and StarSupply status snapshots, then uses the deployed ArmySupplyRules and CampaignRules with the actual campaign configuration.
implementation.upper_bound: Current troop count without supply-efficiency discounts, maximum configured winter food/medical costs and maximum siege food/material/engineering pressure; never below the currently charged demand.
guards: Current correlated demand evidence, active connected army and matching interval/front.
Configured purchase limit, acceptance per-order limit and backpack stack capacity.
Plan output committed only after normal stop and unchanged player save, without overwriting an existing plan.
Same world and plugin hashes; fresh demand rechecked before each budgeted gameplay run.
Increased troop count or larger campaign demand bounds require replanning before more gameplay.
Observed consumption beyond the budget fails the completed physical logistics proof.
implementation.production: All six phases accept the generated plan. Ingredient deficits account for existing outputs and whole recipe yields. Honey waits for natural refills, scaffolding/rockets repeat recipes, furnace input never exceeds 64 items, and construction materials are replenished after travel.
implementation.saved_nbt: The runner validates the same planned output counts; legacy fixed minima cannot pass a larger planned batch.
implementation.provenance: Existing ingredients still need their own acquisition evidence; demand planning does not certify their origin.
